data.action: 单手撑着下颌，酒杯未动
data.description: 【斯卡蒂 · 酒馆角落】伊比利亚沿海嘈杂阴暗的地下酒馆深处，斯卡蒂独自坐在最偏僻昏暗的木桌旁，单手支颐静静注视着面前未动一口的烈朗姆酒。她低垂着眼帘——「陆地上的酒很苦，陆地上的人也很吵……不过，有你坐在我的对面，倒也没那么难以忍受。」
data.promptProse: At a secluded wooden table deep in the Iberian tavern, Skadi supports her chin with one hand and watches her untouched rum. Her white rolled-sleeve shirt and dark apron catch weak amber lantern light above charcoal tailored trousers. In this nighttime medium view, the table edge leads toward a dim bar and heavy beams behind her, with soft shade across her lowered eyes.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 酒馆角落
